description: Grungy, distorted 808s and synth basses that stay full. Start on the simple panel (six macros that bend any preset: Boom, Punch, Grit, Tone, Length, Slide) or open ALL KNOBS for the whole engine, where the Dirt section distorts the top while Sub Keep keeps the clean sub underneath. 131 presets in Travis Scott, Mike Dean, untiljapan, Ye, Yeezus, KING, moshc0re, SAFE, trip-hop, 80s, 2000s, soft and unique styles, plus regular bouncy 808s.
highlights: Simple front panel: six macros (Boom, Punch, Grit, Tone, Length, Slide) over a speaker that moves with the bass; ALL KNOBS opens the full engine, and every control explains itself when you point at it
808 body with punch, warmth and knock, plus two unison synth oscillators
Moog-style ladder filter, glide, release dive, tempo-synced LFO
8 distortion types at 4x oversampling with Sub Keep for heavy-but-full low end
Chorus, delay and space on the top only, so the sub stays mono
POLY switch: play chords with any preset (it stays put when you change presets)

139 presets: Travis, Mike Dean, untiljapan, Ye, Yeezus, moshc0re, KING, trip hop, neo soul, soul, SAFE, 80s, 2000s, bounce 808s, plus SOFT (felt sub, upright, fretless, arco) and UNIQUE (talk box, envelope quack, kalimba, didgeridoo)
Favourites: star the presets you love and browse just those; your stars survive updates
installTips: Notes play at real pitch: the classic 808 range is C2–C3 in FL's piano roll (or use the Octave knob).

items: NEO SOUL and SOUL basses: Voodoo Finger Bass (round, slides, behind the beat), Dilla Moog, Glasper Synth Bass, Chorus Solo Bass, plus Jamerson Flatwound (Motown), Memphis Pick Bass (Stax), Philly Glide Bass and Gospel Pedal Bass
